title: Karaborsa Simülasyonu
description:
Karaborsa Simülasyonu ("Black Market Simulation") is a fully fictional trading and business-management game built from the ground up to be played with a screen reader: every action is announced, every screen works from the keyboard, and nothing depends on seeing anything.

You start with a little cash and build it into an empire, or lose it all trying:

- Buy and sell on a black market where prices shift daily, sometimes violently after a random event
- Open front companies to launder your money and generate passive income
- Invest in real estate and take out loans against land you own
- Hire employees and manage a growing operation
- Hire an informant to warn you before the police catch up with you
- Bid in a live, real-time auction house against named competitors with their own budgets
- Try your luck at a casino
- A public leaderboard, a daily message system and an in-game support system
- Play in Turkey, the US, the UK or Australia, each with its own cities

F1 gives in-game help. The game was written in Turkish; its English text was translated with AI help. It is open source.
